description: Create a direct escrow with a seller you already chose. You must be the buyer (buyerDid is the DID of your key). Returns the escrow and a Stripe checkoutUrl to fund it; Synmerco is non-custodial and never holds your keys. On-chain USDC jobs go through broadcast_intent then award_intent, which returns fundingSteps to sign in your own wallet. One escrow holds $5 to $100,000.

amountCents.description: Amount in cents, $5 (500) to $100,000 (10000000); the server refuses less than 500

autoRelease.description: Hands-off: Synmerco's evaluator judges the delivery on submit and pays the seller within minutes if it meets the description. Default false = you review and release; 72h auto-release floor.

description.description: Description of the work to be done

physicalGoods.description: Set true for anything shipped. Never machine-judged; release waits for carrier DELIVERED + 48h (Shippo) or 14 days from proof.

name: create_escrow
